purpose: Define independent fresh-review batches, required checks and promotion boundaries for the 24 locally reviewed C2-LT-B10 source-context extraction rows without storing verdicts inside the protocol artifact.

scope.selectionRule: Every C2-LT-B10 local-review row must receive independent fresh review before any reviewed artifact, advice-use, intervention-ranking or model-admission claim.
nonClaims: This protocol is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This protocol does not complete Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade-check artifacts.

This protocol does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade, clinical-validity claims, medical advice, device advice, renal dialysis advice, vision rehabilitation advice, hearing-device advice, wound care advice, burn care advice, emergency advice, caregiver advice, nutrition advice or swallowing advice.

promotionRules: support-with-boundary or bounded-support may proceed only to eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill, never directly to model admission, intervention ranking, advice use or clinical-validity claims.
downgrade-required rows must carry a downgrade note before artifact fill and remain blocked for calibrated prediction, individual advice and all B10 advice-use categories.
reject-source-context-mismatch rows must not fill reviewed artifacts until source identity, source role or source context is corrected and independently checked.
cannot-evaluate-insufficient-context rows remain blocked until a primary or authoritative source can be independently checked.
Artifact promotion decisions are limited to eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill, downgrade-before-fill, rejected-no-fill and blocked-cannot-evaluate.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 导尿设备感染、居家透析、外周神经病变、低视力康复、助听维护和手术伤口连续性域
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: independent fresh review must verify device-infection source scope, home-dialysis self-management boundary, peripheral-neuropathy sensory endpoints, low-vision assistive-technology limits, hearing-device maintenance context, surgical-wound/SSI endpoint specificity and no device, dialysis, vision, hearing or wound-care advice overclaim before artifact promotion

reviewBatches.reviewFocus: independent fresh review must verify thermal exposure and resilience scope, burn aftercare/scar-function boundary, diabetic-retinopathy screening and treatment endpoint limits, caregiver-health burden context, choking emergency-risk framing, neurodegenerative dysphagia and nutrition boundaries and no burn-care, emergency, caregiver, nutrition or swallowing advice overclaim before artifact promotion
